brief: Las exportaciones de México alcanzaron un máximo histórico de 80 mil millones de dólares en julio, conforme las importaciones se dispararon para bienes intermedios. Suzuki redujo las ventas mexicanas 18% en los primeros siete meses de 2026, incrementando las importaciones japonesas para contrarrestar presiones arancelarias. La empresa estatal de electricidad de México dependerá de financiamiento del sector privado para la mayoría de sus inversiones durante el período de la Presidenta Sheinbaum.

briefSources.title: CFE to rely on private sector for investment funding
briefSources.summary: Mexico's state electric utility CFE will depend on the private sector to finance most of its investments during President Sheinbaum's term.

briefSources.title: Mexico exports reach record 80 billion dollars in July 2026
briefSources.summary: Mexican exports surpassed 80 billion dollars in July, with imports also at record levels driven by demand for intermediate goods.

briefSources.title: Suzuki increases imports from Japan to offset 50% tariff, adjusts Mexico pricing
briefSources.summary: Suzuki raised imports from Japan while Mexico sales fell 18% in the first seven months of 2026, responding to tariff pressure and shifting its product portfolio.
